note: Ready-made decisions for the manual studio, one per rule in rules.md. Customer-facing: plain language, one sentence each. Keep in step with rules.md.

decisions.text: A cell shows at most three text lines, so the rest continues in the next cell, placed directly below.
A label has one font, weight and colour, so this line uses one style (or is split into separate labels).
Icons can't sit inside a text label, so the line shows text only.
A label's corner radius applies to all four corners or none, so the tag's corners are all the same.
Text can't have a gradient fill, so it uses one colour.
Elements can't be layered over each other, so the effect is drawn into artwork the feed supplies.
The runtime pill always sits bottom right of the image.
A label and the progress bar can't share a line, so the label sits on the line above and the bar leaves room on the right.
A cell with no image can't show badges over a picture.
Labels and icons come from each action, set once for the whole app; the labels are set to match the design.
Each action has one label, so a second navigation button with a different label needs its own action plugin.
Button icons come in two flavours for the whole app, so a one-off icon colour isn't possible.
There is no action to run for this button, so it can't be built; the other buttons are centred instead of leaving a gap.
An icon can't sit straight after the title, so the chevron is an icon-only header button on the right; it still opens the full list.
Cells can't expand or collapse, so the chevron would do nothing and is left out.
A full-width line under both the image and the text isn't possible, so the text stays beside the image.
The text centres against the image when it is shorter than the image.
Dividers are inset by the cell's side padding, so an edge-to-edge divider isn't possible.
Place this cell and the next as single components with no gap so they read as one block.
Supply the artwork in the feed if the exact look must be kept.
Add an action plugin for this button to bring it back.
The feed can add the information as words to the text line instead of icons.
